emails.body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Pragyan Priyadarshini <ppriyadarshini@griddynamics.com>
Date: Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 11:12 AM
Subject: Job Description - Grid Dynamics
To: <nagarajkamath701@gmail.com>


Dear Nagaraj,

Thank you for speaking with me today.

We are excited to share a Job Opportunity @ Grid Dynamics for the position of DevOps Engineer.

Please find the role details below:
We are looking for an experienced SRE / DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, on-premises infrastructure, and Java-based microservices. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining infrastructure reliability, supporting production applications, troubleshooting issues, automating operational tasks, and ensuring high availability and performance across cloud and on-premises environments.

Key Responsibilities
Manage and support AWS cloud infrastructure and on-premises environments.

Administer and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters, containers, and application deployments.

Support Java-based microservices running in production environments.

Monitor application and infrastructure health, availability, performance, and resource utilization.

Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures.

Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions.

Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational tasks.

Support CI/CD pipelines and application release deployments.

Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and application teams to improve system reliability and operational efficiency.

Participate in on-call support and incident management activities as required.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, or Production Reliability Engineering.

Experience managing AWS cloud infrastructure and services.

Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production environments.

Experience supporting on-premises infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.

Experience troubleshooting and supporting Java-based microservices.

Knowledge of Linux system administration, networking, and infrastructure troubleshooting.

Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or CloudWatch.

Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

Knowledge of infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.

Good to Have
Experience with high-availability and distributed systems.

Knowledge of service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and service-level agreements (SLAs).

Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Shell.

Familiarity with application performance monitoring and JVM troubleshooting.

Experience managing production workloads across cloud and on-premises environments.

Next Steps
A Technical Interview will be scheduled and simultaneously, a HackerRank assessment will be shared.
This will be followed by a Managerial round(in-person)
Finally, a client round.
Additionally, please share the following details:

Current CTC 
Expected CTC
Notice Period / Earliest Joining Date
If you have any questions regarding the opportunity, please feel free to reach out.

We look forward to hearing from you and taking your application forward.

About Us

Grid Dynamics (Nasdaq:GDYN) is a digital-native technology services provider that accelerates growth and bolsters competitive advantage for Fortune 1000 companies. Grid Dynamics provides digital transformation consulting and implementation services in omnichannel customer experience, big data analytics, search, artificial intelligence, cloud migration, and application modernization. Grid Dynamics achieves high speed-to-market, quality, and efficiency by using technology accelerators, an agile delivery culture, and its pool of global engineering talent. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the US, UK, Netherlands, Mexico, India, Central and Eastern Europe.

To learn more about Grid Dynamics, please visit www.griddynamics.com. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.


Regards,
Brandmark_small.jpg

Pragyan Priyadarshini

Grid Dynamics

10th Floor, Helios Business Park, Marathahalli - Sarjapur Outer Ring Rd, Kadabeesanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103
Mobile: +91-7978921198
